_comment: Quicksilver dynamic lights (package 13): light levels (0-15) for items and entity types that move. Items that place a block give that block's own light without being listed here; list an item only to give it light its block doesn't have (or to change it). Any mod or resource pack can add assets/<namespace>/quicksilver/dynamic_lights/<name>.json in this form; unknown ids are skipped. Burning entities always give 15.
